title: 第三十二章  移师黑石山谷
slug: 穿越戍边我从炮灰辅卒一路封王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

校场上的风波平息，散漫嚣张的气焰消散。

两百多名士卒列队而立，再也没有了往日摆烂颓废的模样，一股全新的精气神，正在这支杂牌小队身上缓缓凝聚。

立军纪、镇老兵、稳军心，只是第一步。

想要盘活这支没人看好的弱旅，想要摆脱被大营架空、被众将针对的绝境，光靠立威远远不够，还需要一处不受打扰、适合练兵备战的立足之地。

苏烬对着全队高声下令。

“全员听令！收拾随身兵刃行囊，即刻拔营，随我迁出城外！”

这话一出，全场士卒愣住，脸上满是诧异。

石老刀上前一步，拱手沉声问道：“把总，咱们不留在大营驻地，要去往何处？”

苏烬目光望向远方那片熟悉的山峦，声音坚定有力：“黑石戍堡后山，黑石山谷！”

“那里地势隐蔽、山林密布、雪路复杂，远离大营纷争，最适合隐蔽练兵、潜伏备战！往后那里，就是咱们游击小队的专属营地！”

众人恍然大悟。

黑石山谷正是此前苏烬以少胜多、重创羯军的主战场，地形复杂、易守难攻，确实是绝佳的练兵之地。

虽然山谷荒凉苦寒、物资匮乏、条件艰苦，但比起在大营自生自灭，已然是最好的出路。

没有人提出异议，所有人纷纷拱手领命。

“我等遵令！”

短短半柱香时间，众人收拾好仅有的破旧兵刃、列队集结完毕。

苏烬带着刘屯将、石老刀统领全队，朝着黑石山谷的方向行军而去。

沿途不少大营士卒、巡逻兵卒看到这支焕然一新的杂牌队伍，全都满脸惊奇，忍不住低声议论。

谁也想不到，那群人人嫌弃、个个摆烂的残兵烂卒，短短半日时间，竟然被一个年轻小将整治得如此规整听话。

一路风雪兼程，众人徒步穿梭在雪原山林之间。

往日里走这段山路，这群士卒个个叫苦连天、如今全员咬牙坚持、稳步前行。

最后队伍顺利抵达黑石山谷。

这里刚经历过大战，地面上还残留着些许战斗痕迹，断木残枝遍布山野，四周寂静荒凉，寒风穿谷呼啸，环境格外艰苦。

可所有人看着这片山谷，心里非但没有抵触，反而生出一股踏实的感觉。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The turmoil on the campus subsided, and the arrogance and arrogance dissipated.

More than two hundred soldiers stood in formation. They no longer looked like they had been in the past, and a new spirit was slowly gathering in this motley team.

Establishing military discipline, suppressing veterans, and stabilizing military morale are only the first step.

If you want to revitalize this weak brigade that no one is optimistic about, and want to get rid of the desperate situation of being ignored by the camp and being targeted by the generals, it is not enough to establish prestige alone. You also need a foothold that is undisturbed and suitable for training and preparing for war.

Su Jin shouted orders to the entire team.

"Everyone listens to the order! Pack your weapons and luggage, break camp immediately, and follow me out of the city!"

As soon as these words came out, all the soldiers in the audience were stunned, their faces full of surprise.

Shi Laodao took a step forward, cupped his hands and asked in a deep voice: "Boss, if we don't stay at the camp, where are we going?"

Su Jin looked at the familiar mountains in the distance and said in a firm and powerful voice: "The mountains behind the Black Stone Fortress, the Black Stone Valley!"

"The terrain there is hidden, with dense mountains and forests, and complicated snowy roads. It is far away from the disputes in the main camp. It is most suitable for concealed training and preparation for war! There is the exclusive camp for our guerrilla team!"

Everyone suddenly realized.

The Blackstone Valley was the main battlefield where Su Jin had previously defeated the Jie army with a small number and severely damaged the Jie army. The terrain was complex and easy to defend but difficult to attack. It was indeed an excellent place for military training.

Although the valley is desolate and cold, with supplies scarce and conditions difficult, it is the best way out compared to fending for oneself in the camp.

No one raised any objection, and everyone accepted the order.

"I will obey the order!"

In just half a stick of incense, everyone packed up their only worn-out weapons and lined up.

Su Jin took General Liu Tun and Shi Laodao to lead the entire team and marched towards the Black Stone Valley.

Along the way, many soldiers from the camp and patrols were surprised when they saw this new and motley team, and couldn't help but whisper.

No one could have imagined that this group of remnant soldiers who were despised by everyone and were all in ruins, could be so well-organized and obedient by a young general in just half a day.

The journey was windy and snowy, and everyone walked through the snowy mountains and forests.

In the past, when walking this mountain road, this group of soldiers complained a lot, but now they all gritted their teeth and persisted and moved forward steadily.

Finally, the team successfully arrived at Blackstone Valley.

The place had just experienced a war, and there were still some traces of the battle on the ground. Broken trees and branches were scattered all over the mountains and fields. The surrounding area was quiet and desolate. The cold wind howled through the valley, and the environment was extremely difficult.

But when everyone looked at this valley, instead of feeling conflicted, they felt a sense of security.
